XING has over 21 million members who want to find that one special job for them. With over 1.5 million jobs to choose from on Germany’s leading job platform, you can take a step closer to your dream job. Here’s how:


Find matching jobs with powerful filters.

We’ll show you jobs that fit your profile. If you’re looking for a job, you’ll be able to filter companies to find the right one for you. And if you’re just needing a little inspiration, set up a search alert or two and we’ll handle the rest.



Employers who’ll let you peek behind the scenes.

Found an interesting position? Before you start your application, see what you can learn about the company. On XING, you’ll have a direct line to different companies and access to employee reviews about your potential future workplace.


Inspiring people and meaningful contacts
We’ll find people you might already know on XING via the contact finder and personalised contact suggestions. We also put people in similar industries or with similar hobbies on your radar. Your network is there when you’re looking for advice or have exciting news to share. Additionally, if you have questions for certain companies, XING gives you the chance to reach out to their HR managers.


Culture Compass and Culture Assessment

Our Culture Compass and Culture Assessment will help you find out which companies best suit your personality, whether that’s a modern or traditional environment. Knowing whether a good team, appreciation for your work, or career opportunities are important can help improve your job satisfaction in the long run.


Going beyond your CV
Your profile helps you display your knowledge and skills, professional experience, degrees and achievements. Share who you are, what you can do, and what’s important to you. There are more than 20,000 HR professionals actively searching for talent on XING who’d be very interested to see that.



News worth knowing
Whether it’s the newest trends in your industry, deep dives from experts, or tips for your working life. In a sea of 400 plus trade media and insider articles, you’ll be sure to find something that interests you.


XING Premium gives you even more perks
Looking to browse XING anytime, anywhere and take advantage of the many additional features on offer? Upgrade to Premium while using the app.

When upgrading to Premium in the app, you can choose between a 3-month and a 12-month plan. You can cancel your Premium membership, effective from the end of your current term. If you don't cancel, your subscription will renew automatically as a rolling monthly contract, billed one month in advance, unless you terminate your subscription at least 24 hours before the contract period ends.

Pricing (Germany): max. €35.99 for 3 months or max. €119.99 € for 12 months

Outside of Germany, prices will be adjusted to their respective currency and may vary by location. We'll deduct your subscription fee from your iTunes account. Cancellation is not possible after activating your subscription. After purchasing, you can manage your subscriptions in your account settings.

Privacy Policy and GTC
Our Privacy Policy and GTC are available via www.xing.com/mobile and www.xing.com/terms. In addition, the conditions of use of the Apple App Store apply.

If you have any questions or comments, just e-mail us: iphone@xing.com
